interventions.detail: Installed Go 1.24.5 toolchain from go.dev (not in base image, needed to build the scanner)
Built cmd/cli into infra-scan/aig_infra_scan/bin/ai-infra-guard; source checkout ships no binary and README only documents the PyPI wheel
Editable install of infra-scan into a uv venv so the wrapper uses the repo's data/ fingerprint and vuln rules instead of the PyPI-bundled copy
